# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ A helper to safely render a blog entry into an HTML template. """ import html # Pre‑defined template for the blog post BLOG_FORMAT: str = """

{headline}

{text}
""" def display_blog_entry(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Formats a blog entry using the BLOG_FORMAT template. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. text : str The full body of the blog post. Returns ------- str A safe, HTML‑escaped string ready for insertion into a webpage. Notes ----- - The function uses :func:`html.escape` to neutralize any characters that could otherwise break the HTML structure or introduce script injection. - It handles ``None`` values by treating them as empty strings, avoiding TypeErrors during formatting. """ # Convert None to empty string for robustness if headline is None: headline = "" if text is None: text = "" # Escape user input to avoid XSS and malformed HTML safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Insert escaped values into the template formatted_entry = BLOG_FORMAT.format(headline=safe_headline, text=safe_text) return formatted_entry
